newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police intercept U.S.-bound cocaine. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Colombian police intercept U.S.-bound cocaine. [CORRECTED 03:00 GMT]

text.p: Colombian police seized 41 kilos of pure cocaine headed for the United States during a raid on a house in the northwestern province of Antioquia on Tuesday, authorities said. (Corrects weight of drugs from 41 tons to 41 kilos.)
A police spokesman said three suspected drug traffickers were arrested during a raid on a home in the port town of Turbo in the violence-torn banana growing region of Uraba.
In a separate incident Tuesday, police confiscated an arms shipment destined for leftist geurrillas fighting in the northwest of the country, a police spokesman said.
The spokesman said they arrested a man suspected of transporting two dozen AK-47 assault rifles and other arms during a police check of a bus in the northern Cordoba province.
